{{Quote|But my father was kind of a waste of breathable air, so I took my grandfather's family name.|Wran Narcassan on his father|<ref name="MK" />}}
This '''individual''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] and the [[Marriage/Legends|husband]] of [[Vula Nelprin]], a hand-to-hand combat instructor for the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. They had a son named [[Wran Narcassan]], who went on to become a [[Sniper/Legends|sniper]] for [[Wraith Squadron]], a [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[Commando/Legends|commando]] unit. Wran felt his father was not a suitable role model and took up his [[Vyn Narcassan|grandfather's]] family name instead.<ref name="MK" />
